verdict.rationale: Sales Cloud's pricing page lists 'Lead, Account, Contact, and Opportunity Management', which covers contacts and companies (accounts) as core records. It also says AI automatically syncs emails, events, and contacts, which implies activity capture. However, the evidence never explicitly describes the contact-to-account relationship or a per-record activity timeline. missing for 10: explicit documentation of contact–account record linking, a documented per-record activity timeline view, independent or hands-on corroboration.
